resources.string: Check the input definition and values. Place each placeholder outside quotes as a separate argument.
The command is inserted into the terminal. Review it, then press Enter. Chosen files are copied into the local shell home.
In the command: {{text}}, {{width:number=1080}}, {{format:choice=png|jpg}}, {{image:file}}. Names become field labels. Put placeholders outside quotes.
The command can read $Z2_SHARE_TEXT and $Z2_SHARE_MANIFEST (receipt JSON). File inputs can use received attachments.
The text and attachments are saved together. Choose a saved command or insert the original content. Commands run after you press Enter.
